home.seo_desc: Building fast, secure, and user-friendly mobile and web applications.
home.hero_subtitle: We build small Android apps for everyday things — checking card balances, reading QRIS codes, following along at a tahlil. Built at home, used at home, passed on to whoever needs them.
home.hero_signature: do code for fun, no.. serious things.
home.origin_p1: A baskom is the enamel basin in every Indonesian kitchen — green marbled splash, white inside, dark blue rolled rim. Cheap, dented, immortal. Nobody treats a baskom as something precious, and that is exactly the point. Everything gets mixed in it: dough, rujak, laundry, coconut ice for the neighbourhood feast.
home.origin_p2: Ours just happens to be full of code. Ideas go in, get stirred, and come out as apps — built at home, used at home, passed on to whoever needs them. No ceremony.
home.qrstu_desc: Scan a QRIS code, unpack what is inside it, and learn how it works.
home.pembacakue_desc: Check eMoney, Flazz, and other NFC card balances straight from your phone.
home.yasintahlil_desc: Yasin, Tahlil, Maulid & Sholawat in full — works without an internet connection.
home.nfc_desc: We tinker with NFC to connect cards and phones safely — from reading an eMoney balance to understanding the conversation between a card and a reader. That is what PembacaKUE is made of.
home.contact_desc: Want to talk about a project, found a bug in one of our apps, or just curious about something? Say hello.

footer.signature: do code for fun, no.. serious things.
